source.note: No Java, JMeter, JVM, plugin artifact, GUI, display server, or subprocess was run while creating this corpus.

validation_contract.validator_scope: static schema, profile-reference, XML topology, plugin-contract, disabled-content, and input-hash checks only
validation_contract.comparator_scope: Plugin-editor GUI comparison is not implemented; this descriptor is a declarative positive/unavailable/no-drop contract, not captured GUI evidence
validation_contract.activation: Enable comparison only after a dedicated GUI plugin-editor comparator, pinned plugin artifact, and JVM/OS evidence are recorded.

plugin_editor_contract.artifact_status: not bundled; exact positive artifact is a future external pin

positive.identity: strict equality for plugin class/gui-class, source/version/license, ordered classpath and artifact hashes
positive.outcome: planned editor load/save observation; no fallback

unavailable.outcome: typed unavailable result; no native plugin-host fallback; source remains opaque

opaque_plugin_subtree.no_drop_requirement: Both class attributes and both XML-decoded property values remain exact through unavailable load/save and headless preservation.

headless_contract.source_gui_metadata: retain plugin testclass/guiclass/testname/enabled and unknown properties
headless_contract.plugin_execution: forbidden when the plugin capability is unavailable
headless_contract.status: planned; no headless process was run

preservation_rules: The positive route may only use the exact declared plugin editor identity and cannot fall through to native or unrelated plugin-host behavior.
The unavailable route returns runtime.capability.unsupported with no source guessing or partial editor substitution.
The opaque plugin element, guiclass/testclass attributes, property insertion order, XML-decoded Unicode, and disabled state are never silently dropped.

oracle_observation.required_before_promotion: Pinned plugin-editor positive and missing-capability runs on each declared GUI platform/Java lane
